Held session 1303am: a stand 2.1 m out from the axis through the tank's live position, facing it, 20 degrees down, showed 'Whale Oil Tank Cover - Open'. The deck carries the player with the top. One press opened the cover ('Whale Oil Tank - Carry'), the next carried the tank: Task_IS_Turn_OFF_the_watchtower complete, Task_IS_Talk_to_Meagan active (named states). A press at Meagan first drops the carried tank; the next started the departure, and the host reached its result screen (logic 11, resultsSwitches 1) without sending the mission end (result armed).

Root cause (confirmed runtime, 1303am): idCommonLocal+0x2b8 (the idDeclMapInfo that readCurrentMapinfo reads) is null in both worlds during a mission started with the native campaign command, even in plain gameplay, so the sender's mapinfo read failed silently and the observation was consumed. The same read names the host's mission for join-follow (D2MF). 1214bu derives the mapinfo from the loaded map name when the declaration is absent (the directory plus the name without _p, _p_lowchaos or _p_highchaos; this names an existing mapinfo for all 35 campaign maps, confirmed static), keeps the last identity for moments without a loaded map name, refreshes it every second in gameplay, and reports (mapinfo_unreadable, not_connected, send_failed) and retries failed sends for 30 s.
The tank step now stands 2.1 m out from the watchtower axis through the tank's live position (orbit), with eight presses at 20 degrees (route institute-full-v1303an).

Take 1303an (1214bu): the orbit stand worked on the first two tries (cover, then carry; Task_IS_Turn_OFF_the_watchtower complete in both worlds), and the gameflow counts were equal in both worlds after the Vasco talk ([230,2,3,10,0,3,0]; before 1214bt the partner had one extra state 5), so #87's reset holds. The mission identity now reads campaign/institute/institute.mapinfo in both worlds. But the Meagan step's first press dropped the carried tank and its second, 6 degrees off, counted as the talk because Meagan's one-liner scene changed the cinematic epoch; the harness then reported a pass with both worlds still on the institute map. The Meagan step now counts only a press that leaves gameplay (expect logic), and routes end with an expect step that fails the take unless both worlds reach the next map.
